request.source:
! Original OpenSwing guided-motion verification model. SI input units.
! One kilogram at the origin, principal inertias (2,3,4) kg m^2.
! No aerodynamic surface or volume. Set gravity to zero for inertial checks.
! Mixed motion can prescribe selected accelerations and solve others from loads.
! Net Fx includes inertial reaction: without external force, ax = -Fx / mass.
Name
Guided rigid-body demonstrator
End
Unit
L 1 m
T 1 s
F 1 N
End
Constant
9.80665 1.225 340.294
End
Reference
2 1 2
0 0 0
0 0 0
0 0 0
End
Ground
1 0 0
End
Weight
1 0 0 0 0 9.80665 0 0 0 0 0 19.6133 29.41995 39.2266
End
Beam 1
Rigid frame
t y
0 0
2 2
End

limitations: Loaded base state for the frozen harmonic linearization.
SO(3) midpoint beam discretization; refine the mesh to assess solution accuracy. ASWING discrete parity is unverified.
Rigid/pinned/roller/sprung joints, axial struts, body/point-volume flow and engine types 0/1/2 are supported.
Struts use an explicit bilateral or tension-only wire law; buckling loads are not specified by ASW input. See the numerical notes for formula ambiguities.
CDi is the near-field lift-force projection; Trefftz-plane integration is pending.
Mechanical strain is recovered from current geometry; total section loads include material damping and do not alone determine strain.
Cshell/Nshell are offsets from the tension axis per steady eq. 28; the user guide labels them relative to the elastic axis. Executable parity is unverified.
The strain bound sums absolute axial and bending contributions. It bounds the specified rectangular extents, not an unspecified complete cross section.

Torsional shear stress assumes a thin, closed, uniform shell: torque about the elastic axis divided by twice Atshell. Transverse-shear stress, warping, normal stress and strength margins are not inferred.
Missing shell arms or nonpositive Atshell produce null material results. Negative Atshell is invalid; shell parameters do not change equilibrium.
These are element midpoint samples. Peaks at endpoints, joints and concentrated loads require local refinement; no interpolation across jumps is implied.
Sensor axes and locations follow their rigid pylons. Relative body position/velocity describe the beam anchor; GPS and inertial measurements describe the pylon tip.
Full airflow includes the implemented regularized lifting-line, volume, propulsive jet and gust fields. Near-filament/core and ASWING sensor-flow parity require independent refinement.

Structural force/moment use the inward endpoint trace and left trace at an interior anchor, in the anchor csn frame. Both adjacent traces are exported; exact ASWING trace choice at load/property jumps is unverified.
Mechanical strain and shell stress use the selected adjacent element material midpoint, whose location is reported. They are not exact nodal or pylon-tip strain measurements.
Zero airspeed makes flow angles undefined. At a vertical sensor V axis, bank/heading are undefined; Euler-angle branches are not a global attitude representation.
Selected measurements can drive scheduled feedback and differential error integrals. Full control-file index/unit mapping and arbitrary custom controller parity remain unverified.

equilibrium_state.units: Physical quantities in ASW input units; spatial rotation vectors in radians. Numerical solver scales are not stored.
limitations: This is a steady state. It contains no unsteady history or derivative state.
The source and mesh must match. Steady reuse corrects the full equilibrium; time launch validates the saved setup at zero local rates.
Local correction does not prove that a nonlinear branch is unique or that a fold has been followed.

samples.error: Singular harmonic pencil: a pole, unconstrained motion or zero-frequency free-flight integrator.

node_coordinates.order: interleaved body translation / L and spatial rotation in radians

material_damping.note: A constitutive diagnostic only: aeroelastic stability and passivity of the full discretization are not established.

diagnostics.equation: (i omega M - A) xhat = B; x(t)=base+Re(xhat exp(i omega t)); unit input amplitude.
diagnostics.units: Angular frequency rad/input T; frequency cycles/input T; response per stated input unit.

limitations: Experimental full-descriptor harmonic particular response. ASWING discrete parity and measured frequency-response validation remain unverified.
Base coefficients are frozen. Stability and transient decay are not established by a Bode solve; check eigenmodes and the base drift/timescale.
Real inertia, apparent mass, material damping, circulation lag and direct input/rate-dependent loads are retained. The empirical gust response is not exact Sears/Theodorsen theory.
Convected gusts satisfy omega = k dot U_E at the body origin. Spatial phase and span parity use the loaded base and are sampled at the actual fluid load/control locations.
Frequency singularities are reported as missing responses, never filled by a pseudoinverse. Zero-frequency free-flight position/attitude integrators commonly make the full pencil singular.

Controls are held or constrained by declared feedback laws. Controlled-actuator and selected measurement commands act through the complete controller residual, including integrated errors. Active frame load targets and prescribed accelerations can be harmonic inputs. Broken-loop display and general inverse dynamic constraints remain pending.
Input amplitude and display scale must remain small enough for the linearization. Refine the mesh, frequency range and difference step; monitor gust spatial phase resolution.

Prescribed and mixed motion retain all twelve frame kinematic states; selected accelerations follow net-load targets and other accelerations remain prescribed. Fixed frame omits these states entirely.

Declared feedback adds algebraic actuator settings and differential error integrals. Other settings are held at their solved base values. Arbitrary custom controller and full control-file parity remain unverified.

comparison.note: Defective kinematic zero roots can split numerically; individual small growth rates are not established physical instability.

! Original OpenSwing guided-motion verification model. SI input units.
! One kilogram at the origin, principal inertias (2,3,4) kg m^2.
! No aerodynamic surface or volume. Set gravity to zero for inertial checks.
! Mixed motion can prescribe selected accelerations and solve others from loads.
! Net Fx includes inertial reaction: without external force, ax = -Fx / mass.
Name
Guided rigid-body demonstrator
End
Unit
L 1 m
T 1 s
F 1 N
End
Constant
9.80665 1.225 340.294
End
Reference
2 1 2
0 0 0
0 0 0
0 0 0
End
Ground
1 0 0
End
Weight
1 0 0 0 0 9.80665 0 0 0 0 0 19.6133 29.41995 39.2266
End
Beam 1
Rigid frame
t y
0 0
2 2
End

Engine
1 0 1 0 0 0 0 1 0 0 1 0 -1 0 0
End

limitations: Loaded base state for the frozen harmonic linearization.
SO(3) midpoint beam discretization; refine the mesh to assess solution accuracy. ASWING discrete parity is unverified.
Rigid/pinned/roller/sprung joints, axial struts, body/point-volume flow and engine types 0/1/2 are supported.
Struts use an explicit bilateral or tension-only wire law; buckling loads are not specified by ASW input. See the numerical notes for formula ambiguities.
CDi is the near-field lift-force projection; Trefftz-plane integration is pending.
Mechanical strain is recovered from current geometry; total section loads include material damping and do not alone determine strain.
Cshell/Nshell are offsets from the tension axis per steady eq. 28; the user guide labels them relative to the elastic axis. Executable parity is unverified.
The strain bound sums absolute axial and bending contributions. It bounds the specified rectangular extents, not an unspecified complete cross section.

Torsional shear stress assumes a thin, closed, uniform shell: torque about the elastic axis divided by twice Atshell. Transverse-shear stress, warping, normal stress and strength margins are not inferred.
Missing shell arms or nonpositive Atshell produce null material results. Negative Atshell is invalid; shell parameters do not change equilibrium.
These are element midpoint samples. Peaks at endpoints, joints and concentrated loads require local refinement; no interpolation across jumps is implied.
Sensor axes and locations follow their rigid pylons. Relative body position/velocity describe the beam anchor; GPS and inertial measurements describe the pylon tip.
Full airflow includes the implemented regularized lifting-line, volume, propulsive jet and gust fields. Near-filament/core and ASWING sensor-flow parity require independent refinement.

Structural force/moment use the inward endpoint trace and left trace at an interior anchor, in the anchor csn frame. Both adjacent traces are exported; exact ASWING trace choice at load/property jumps is unverified.
Mechanical strain and shell stress use the selected adjacent element material midpoint, whose location is reported. They are not exact nodal or pylon-tip strain measurements.
Zero airspeed makes flow angles undefined. At a vertical sensor V axis, bank/heading are undefined; Euler-angle branches are not a global attitude representation.
Selected measurements can drive scheduled feedback and differential error integrals. Full control-file index/unit mapping and arbitrary custom controller parity remain unverified.

controller_equilibrium.initialization: Commands default to measurements at the loaded structure with the prescribed operating settings; initial_integrals are guesses in steady equilibrium.
controller_equilibrium.integral_condition: measurement - command = 0 for every selected integrated error

equilibrium_state.units: Physical quantities in ASW input units; spatial rotation vectors in radians. Numerical solver scales are not stored.
limitations: This is a steady state. It contains no unsteady history or derivative state.
The source and mesh must match. Steady reuse corrects the full equilibrium; time launch validates the saved setup at zero local rates.
Local correction does not prove that a nonlinear branch is unique or that a fold has been followed.

equilibrium_initialization.initialization: Commands default to measurements at the loaded structure with the prescribed operating settings; initial_integrals are guesses in steady equilibrium.
equilibrium_initialization.integral_condition: measurement - command = 0 for every selected integrated error

controller.equation: Scheduled law, target expression or implicit actuator residual; integral_dot = measurement - command; custom_state_dot = rate expression
limitations: Declarative expressions and scheduled laws replace user CONTROL routines; they do not execute Fortran or Python source.
Angles and angular rates in named feedback channels use degrees. Global Ax/Ay/Az are absolute reference accelerations; sensor accelerometers measure specific force.
Commands default to initial measured values; actuator bias defaults to the solved open-loop setting. Angle errors use the shortest signed branch.
No actuator dynamics, saturation or anti-windup is added implicitly. Gain-table behavior outside the grid is explicit.

node_coordinates.order: interleaved body translation / L and spatial rotation in radians

material_damping.note: A constitutive diagnostic only: aeroelastic stability and passivity of the full discretization are not established.

diagnostics.equation: (i omega M - A) xhat = B; x(t)=base+Re(xhat exp(i omega t)); unit input amplitude.
diagnostics.units: Angular frequency rad/input T; frequency cycles/input T; response per stated input unit.

limitations: Experimental full-descriptor harmonic particular response. ASWING discrete parity and measured frequency-response validation remain unverified.
Base coefficients are frozen. Stability and transient decay are not established by a Bode solve; check eigenmodes and the base drift/timescale.
Real inertia, apparent mass, material damping, circulation lag and direct input/rate-dependent loads are retained. The empirical gust response is not exact Sears/Theodorsen theory.
Convected gusts satisfy omega = k dot U_E at the body origin. Spatial phase and span parity use the loaded base and are sampled at the actual fluid load/control locations.
Frequency singularities are reported as missing responses, never filled by a pseudoinverse. Zero-frequency free-flight position/attitude integrators commonly make the full pencil singular.

Controls are held or constrained by declared feedback laws. Controlled-actuator and selected measurement commands act through the complete controller residual, including integrated errors. Active frame load targets and prescribed accelerations can be harmonic inputs. Broken-loop display and general inverse dynamic constraints remain pending.
Input amplitude and display scale must remain small enough for the linearization. Refine the mesh, frequency range and difference step; monitor gust spatial phase resolution.

spectrum.left_recovery: Matched full-pencil generalized Schur vectors, with checked null-space fallback and repeated-pole pairing

diagnostics.projection: Left mass-dual projection with complete real conjugate pairs; algebraic input lift uses the full finite subspace.

controller.equation: Scheduled law, target expression or implicit actuator residual; integral_dot = measurement - command; custom_state_dot = rate expression
limitations: Declarative expressions and scheduled laws replace user CONTROL routines; they do not execute Fortran or Python source.

Commands default to initial measured values; actuator bias defaults to the solved open-loop setting. Angle errors use the shortest signed branch.
No actuator dynamics, saturation or anti-windup is added implicitly. Gain-table behavior outside the grid is explicit.

equations: dy = C z + D du + D_rate d(du)/dt
limitations: This is a local frozen linear model. Truncated stable, unstable or lightly damped modes can change response and stability conclusions; compare the full system across the intended frequency range and refine the mode set and mesh.
Conjugate pairs are retained together. Dependent or defective selected modes are rejected; generalized eigenvector/Jordan models are not yet supported.

Constant real inputs support flap/engine settings, selected controller commands, active frame targets, prescribed accelerations and fixed spatial gusts. Convected gust phase requires frequency-dependent input matrices and is not supported by this constant-matrix export.

The algebraic lift retains direct constraint and acceleration response. Inputs requiring derivatives in the descriptor state are rejected. D_rate explicitly represents any derivative-input sensor feedthrough.
Named global and Sensor measurements use file physical units; all angular measurement outputs use degrees. State-lift rows use the documented scaled descriptor coordinates.
OpenSwing ROM JSON and text are versioned original formats. Legacy ASWING .rom byte compatibility and published aircraft/experimental ROM validation remain unverified.
Independent rigid-body, controller and reduced-model component checks; not ASWING executable or experimental validation.
Nonstationary operating points use frozen coefficients; a harmonic particular solution does not establish trajectory stability.
General inverse dynamic constraints and generalized/defective mode ROMs remain pending.
